reason: The cited evidence shows that Al-containing coatings on Zr-alloys can improve corrosion resistance via oxide formation (E1), but it does not demonstrate preferential Al2O3 scale formation, its efficacy as a Cr–Zr diffusion barrier, or maintained performance under normal PWR conditions for a Cr/Al interlayer system. The key mechanistic premises are therefore largely unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: An Al-rich interlayer will oxidize preferentially to form a dense Al2O3 scale at high temperature.
The Al2O3 scale acts as an effective diffusion barrier against Cr–Zr interdiffusion.
The Al-rich interlayer does not degrade corrosion resistance under normal PWR subcritical water conditions.
Al-containing coatings on Zr-alloys can form protective oxide layers.
